note: Source of truth for the Litho Formula preset gallery. Artists add shapes by editing this file — no code changes needed. Each preset gives the two Litho Formula parameter sets (theta = longitude factor, phi = latitude factor), the voxel grid resolution (power of two, 8..64), a .lthm palette material id, and a one-line description. Parameter sets are Wet Wafer Works' own tuning.
